assumptions: Recourse debt remains legally due after default and impairment; no forgiveness or new nominal borrowing is authorized. This is a chosen hypothetical rule, not protocol or legal advice.
Collateral is held by Custodian for Borrower and encumbered to Loan1; it is not a separate Pool NAV asset while the loan receivable is included.
Buyer has400 Cash and a bound4 Collateral for400 Cash executable bid; no oracle valuation is treated as money. Bid authenticity and custody availability are assumed external inputs.
Loss is allocated pari passu by fixed HolderA600/HolderB400 shares; no junior tranche, reserve absorption or insurance. Accounting claims are not immediate withdrawal entitlements.
Pool bears liquidation fee10 after borrower receives gross400 nominal repayment credit. Borrower separately bears later recovery fee5 in addition to nominal payment150. No fee capitalizes debt.
Impairment600 anticipates recoverable receivable400 before sale; successful later repayment150 reverses150 impairment. Fees and impairment gains/losses are separately recorded.

Each declared event costs1 ordinary work. Closure reserve2 cannot fund these operations. Failed tentative actions have no accepted financial changes; host/network charges are outside this design oracle.
No maturity accrual, new loan, share issuance, redemption, cancellation, forgiveness, price manipulation protection or guaranteed future recovery is modeled.
